newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ausdoc announces share buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ausdoc announces share buyback plan.

text.p: Document exchange firm Ausdoc Group Ltd said on Tuesday that it planned a six month share buy-back programme to commence on December 31.
Ausdoc said it would buy-back on-market up to 5.1 million ordinary shares representing about nine percent of its issued capital which based on current prices would cost the company about A$8 million.
"The share buy-back programme will be funded from the proceeds of the sale of Ausdoc Office to be received December 30, 1996," the company said in a statement.
The company said the initiative was subject to prevailing market conditions and the Directors assessment of the underlying value of Ausdoc shares.

"The board considers that at current market prices Ausdoc shares are undervalued. Furthermore, following settlement on the sale of Ausdoc Office, Ausdoc will be effectively ungeared," Ausdoc managing director, Peter Reilly said.

The company said thatin conjunction with the buy-back programme, it would continue to seek out opportunities to acquire businesses which fitted with its core document exchange business or logical extensions of those businesses.
Ausdoc sold its office products unit, Ausdoc Office to an Australian subsidiary of Blue Star Group Ltd, a New Zealand based subsidiary of US Office Products Co in September for about A$43 million.
At 1.25 p.m. (0225 GMT), Ausdoc shares were 10 cents firmer at A$1.62.
